different_from_old_direct_cache.old_mechanism: Whole-row CTA32 only: admitted misses go directly shared->cache victim, other misses shared->staging; one HBM store per unique page. Existing chunk flag release/acquire guards both metadata and bytes; attention maps admitted staging entries to victim after that acquire. No changing policy/capacity/far bytes/simulator/reference, one kernel.
different_from_old_direct_cache.new_difference: No dependent perKV victim lookup; rewrite remap once before fetch. Perpage cache-ready slot_page plus chunkready staging; two additional gridbarriers and upfrontLRU are explicit costs.
